about_the_game:
Content Available in This Demo Version

● 4 Playable Characters: Unlock each character's skills and assign them as the leader to experience different battle dynamics!

● Card Enhancements: Upgrade your hand cards during battles—this might just be your key to turning the tide!

● Roguelite Mechanics: Character skills, Spell Cards, and enhancement buffs make each battle uniquely unpredictable.

● Strategic Depth: Enemy mechanics vary, so targeting their weaknesses flexibly is crucial.

Touhou Unite Arena is a fan-made game inspired by the Touhou Project. Players can form their own squad, assign a leader, and experience various in-game events to strengthen their [Combat Spell Cards], collect [Fantasy Spell Cards], upgrade characters, and unlock more powerful skills.

Playable Characters & Enemies

The game features familiar characters from the Touhou Project, each with unique skills to help your squad achieve victory.
The enemies you encounter are also from the Touhou Project, each equipped with interesting skill mechanics based on their traits—choose the right moment to break their defenses, or go all-in for a finish. The choice is yours.

Combat Spell Cards & Combos

Use correctly combined [Combat Spell Cards] to unleash skills during battles, deal damage, and defeat enemies. You can target enemy weaknesses repeatedly or opt for higher-level skill combos. Enemy HP is limited—but the combinations of your [Combat Spell Cards] are practically infinite.

The Magic of Fantasy Spell Cards

Victory in battles or event triggers may randomly reward you with various [Fantasy Spell Cards]. Some directly enhance your leader, others strengthen your [Card Combo] skills or upgrade your [Combat Spell Cards]. Some can even be used directly to turn the tide of battle.

short_description: "Touhou Unite Arena" is a card Roguelike game based on the theme of the Touhou Project. Build your own team, combine the spell cards in your hand, play explosive attack values, defeat the target enemy step by step, and challenge the final champion!
